_readme: Your master resume library. Every point you have ever written lives here ONCE; each track (resume type) picks and orders some of them. Easiest way to edit: the Resume Editor (http://127.0.0.1:3002). Replace everything in CAPITALS / marked EXAMPLE with your real facts, and delete examples you don't need. Bullet status: ok = may print; confirm = not checked yet, never prints on a track resume; never = kept only as a record. Track ids: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
